_doc: Dustwind Pass, the Caravan map: a long canyon road, mirrored left to right so both rounds are fair. The caravan rides 'track' (floor pixels, from red's end on the left to blue's on the right). Boulder walls and scrub give cover off the road; nothing sits on it. Rects are [col, row, width, height] in 8 px cells on the 220x40 grid.
name: Dustwind Pass

tiles._doc: Szadi art's Desert (tools/tile_recipes/desert.json): tan sand with a gravel verge, a packed-earth road under the caravan's track, dry scrub round the brush beds; the walls stand as runs of stacked rock (styles.wall, loose rocks where one is smashed) and the beds as the Desert's own scrub shrubs (styles.brush); low rock heaps, agave and palms stand in the margins only (decor draws under the fighters, and under the crowd: the top margin's verge is about a tile tall, so its rocks stay that low and only the palms' canopies reach behind the stands). The caravan stops are dressed from RPG_Buildings_Desert on the wall runs beside them (a decor or anim piece whose feet stand on a wall cell joins the run and goes while that wall is smashed): only a run's near end shows a piece whole (the pillars in front hide the rest), so each run gets one: a pillar brazier on the tall runs by the stops, a pile of goods on the low runs south of the road, a tripod brazier on the short end runs; the side walkways at both ends carry a narrow banner rack (red's side red, blue's slate), a pillar brazier either side of the road and a pile of goods. Booths and thatch stalls (64 and 128 px wide) fit on neither a one-tile wall run nor the walkway, so they wait for the margin ruling. The road's verges are worn (sand_dirt patches on the 4-tile grid, so the clods show whole) and the open sand carries gravel patches. Rects are [tx, ty, w, h] in 32 px tiles (2 x 2 cells) on the 110 x 20 floor. Built into assets/arenas/caravan_pass.tscn by tools/build_tiles.gd.

light._doc: hard desert sun from the top left: dark shadows

grade._doc: bleached desert warmth; a view-only tint and vignette (GradeView), eased at night/sunset/rain by weather.json

ambient._doc: blown sand, scrub that sways, grit off the boulders, a dust devil and the odd vulture; see AmbientView
